comparator_baseline_summary.interpretation: Meaningful local Phase V baseline: the declared conventional comparator reproduces the current V001-V035 CR corpus across all scored axes. This does not establish production conformance, independent reproduction, semantic correctness, or formal irreducibility.

adversarial_execution_summary.scope_boundary: This pass executes first-order generated cases against encoded metamorphic property obligations and mutation controls. It does not execute every higher-order composition case and does not test the production kernel.

closure_execution_summary.claim_boundary: This closes the repository-local CR-Core reference/evaluator closure campaign over encoded comparator fixtures, metamorphic obligations, pair interactions, recursive chains, selected higher-order reductions, and mutation controls. It is not production-kernel conformance and not independent third-party validation.

adversarial_surface_summary.interpretation: The repository-local reference closure campaign executed first-order, pair interaction, recursive-chain, selected higher-order reduction, mutation, and local reproduction checks with no unexplained minimized failures. Production-kernel conformance remains separate.

primary_metric.name: unexplained_minimized_failures
primary_metric.meaning: From this point forward, closure is measured by how many minimized failures cannot be explained by the existing V001-V035 semantic basis, not by raw generated test count.

closure_campaign_order: Map minimized failures back to V001-V035
Create V036+ only when reduction fails
Repeat until no unexplained semantic class remains
freeze_gate: CR-Core freezes when independently frozen evaluators agree on the declared semantic corpus; generated adversarial composition produces no unexplained minimized semantic obligations; metamorphic invariants hold across the tested search space; deliberately defective semantic mutations are detected; and every exception has a classified, reproducible disposition.
